step1_figure.circuit_type: Switched-capacitor sample-and-hold circuit using two-stage op-amp without CMFB
step1_figure.description: Figure 26.25 shows a fully-differential switched-capacitor sample-and-hold circuit using the two-stage class-AB op-amp of Fig. 26.22 with 50 fF compensation capacitors, 250 fF sampling and load capacitors, and three-phase non-overlapping clock switches (phi1, phi2, phi3) illustrating output common-mode wandering.

output_cm_wandering.description: Downward drift/wandering of the op-amp output common-mode voltage over time caused by the absence of a CMFB circuit

equation.explanation: Without a common-mode feedback circuit, charge injection, parasitic coupling, and bias asymmetry cause the output common-mode level to wander downwards over successive clock cycles until the op-amp eventually shuts off.
equation.assumptions: Three-phase clock operation at 50 MHz over a 200 ns simulation window

sky130_expected.calculation: In Fig. 26.25, the initial output common-mode starts near 400 mV at t = 10 ns and drops to ~300 mV at t = 200 ns, showing Delta_VCM_wander = 400 mV - 300 mV = 100 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: As shown in the transient simulation plot of Fig. 26.25, the output common-mode level continuously wanders downward towards ground over 200 ns.

slew_rate.description: Slew rate of the differential amplifier driving the compensation capacitors

equation.explanation: The maximum rate of voltage change across the compensation capacitor Cc is set by the tail/diff-amp bias current.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With Itail nominally around 20 uA in the diff-pair branch and Cc = 50 fF, the slew rate evaluates to 400 V/us.

quiescent_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from VDD under balanced operating conditions

equation.explanation: There are eight vertical branches in the core two-stage op-amp, each conducting approximately 20 uA quiescent current.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_DD,core = 8 * 20 uA = 160 uA. Including the reference bias generator SUB_1 (~50 uA), total current is ~210 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Text explicitly estimates 8 * 20 uA = 160 uA for the op-amp plus ~50 uA for the bias circuit.

output_cm_offset.description: Offset of the op-amp output common-mode voltage from the ideal common-mode voltage VCM

equation.explanation: Without CMFB, the outputs balance at approximately 400 mV due to output buffer diode-connected NMOS symmetry instead of the desired VCM = 500 mV.

sky130_expected.calculation: VCM_out = 400 mV, VCM = 500 mV -> V_OS,CM = 400 mV - 500 mV = -100 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Figure 26.23 shows the differential outputs crossing at 400 mV rather than 500 mV, resulting in a -100 mV DC CM offset.

open_loop_gain.description: DC open-loop differential voltage gain of the two-stage op-amp

equation.explanation: Product of the first-stage cascode diff-amp gain (~40) and the second-stage class AB buffer gain (~10).
equation.assumptions: No resistive DC load on outputs

sky130_expected.reasoning: The text notes the first stage cascode has a gain of ~40 and the second stage has a gain of ~10-12, yielding Av ~ 400 to 500.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench simulating the switched-capacitor sample-and-hold circuit of Fig. 26.25 over 200 ns with three-phase non-overlapping clocks (phi1, phi2, phi3) and 5 MHz sinusoidal differential input to measure output common-mode wandering, DC CM offset, quiescent power, and op-amp slew rate.
